item.title: Emek Hefer swim and aquathlon to take place on November 21 at the Beit Yanai beaches
item.description: The event includes swims from 600 meters to 4.7 km and aquathlon heats for adults and children, at the beaches of Beit Yanai National Park.

item.title: Kfar Yona: 94% bagrut eligibility, a new business community and programming courses for teenagers
item.description: The Kfar Yona Municipality published a series of updates for residents in October, from education data to guidelines ahead of the Knesset elections.

item.title: Matriculation eligibility rate in Netanya reaches 87.5%, the city's highest in a decade
item.description: According to Education Ministry data for the 2024-25 school year, the city's eligibility rate rose by 2.7 percentage points in one year and clearly passed the national average.

item.title: Dora compound: municipality backs away from capping the added area of the new apartments
item.description: After a lengthy legal process, the district appeals committee determined that the addition to apartments in the renewal project in southern Netanya will not be capped.

item.title: Maccabi Netanya beat Ironi Kiryat Shmona 1-0 and ended a run of four games without a win
item.description: A second-half penalty gave Roni Levy's team three points, its first clean sheet since the opening round, and a move up to sixth place.

item.title: Renewal plan near Independence Square in Netanya deposited: 114 apartments instead of 49
item.description: The plan on HaMitmad and Bialik streets includes a 27-floor tower, and objections can now be filed against it.

item.title: Appeals committee: betterment levy in the Nordau Max project expected to fall by tens of millions of shekels
item.description: The arbitrating appraiser estimated the levy at about NIS 10.45 million, much less than the municipality's original demand, and the final decision is still open.

item.title: Five pinui-binui (demolish and rebuild) plans in Netanya head for deposit, with about 1,300 new apartments
item.description: The subcommittee for planning and building decided to deposit, with conditions, five plans in the city center, Kiryat Nordau and Neot Shaked, which will replace hundreds of old apartments.

item.title: Netanya Beach Race returns: Friday, December 4, with start and finish at Poleg Beach
item.description: The race combines road running and sand running, and will include 10 km and 5 km heats alongside community runs for children and families.
